entries.description: An unstable shade that chooses unpredictably between attacking and defending.
A patient scavenger that spends most turns reinforcing its defences before striking.
A corrupted devotee whose stored armour also empowers its next attack.
An armoured sentinel that retaliates when its shield is broken, then restores its guard.
A fallen warrior whose attacks become far more dangerous below half health.
The final guardian of the ruins, using phase-based attacks, defences and debilitating magic.
